source_passage: Australia's largest grocery retailer with a very large consumer attack surface and a confirmed high-severity breach: its MyDeal subsidiary's CRM was accessed via a compromised credential, exposing ~2.2 million customers' PII (Oct 2022), OAIC-notified under the NDB scheme. Recurring human-error exposure (the e-gift-card spreadsheet leak) and a sprawling subsidiary base (Quantium/wiq, Petstock, PFD, PetCulture) compound supply-chain and data-governance risk. Sheer size, multiple consumer-data brands and a real breach history make it highly amenable. MyDeal (Woolworths subsidiary) breach: ~2.2M customers' names/emails/phones/addresses (some DOBs) exposed via compromised credential into CRM; data offered for sale (Oct 2022) OAIC notified under NDB scheme; OAIC statement confirming engagement on compliance Insider/human-error e-gift-card leak (~8,000 cards, >A$1m) emailed to 1,000+ customers (2015; resurfaced as case study 2023) Majority-owned subsidiary: Quantium / wiq (~75-80%), which also serves CBA, Qantas, Flight Centre, Telstra Subsidiary: MyDeal.com.au (~80%) — breach source Subsidiaries: Petstock (55%), PFD Food Services (100%), PetCulture JV (~60%; pet insurance via PetSure/Hollard) Former subsidiary: Endeavour Group (demerged Jul 2021; final stake exited Sep 2024) Major supplier: Costa Group (fresh produce) Delivery partners: DoorDash (current), Uber Eats (historical) External auditor: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Competitors: Coles, ALDI, Metcash/IGA
